name: line_fit
description: Pose-aligned search line. The search line is authored in a BASELINE pose frame (config); at runtime it is transformed by the (current vs baseline) pose delta. A demo of fixturing + typed I/O wiring — see docs/internals/typed-io.md.

params.name: line_x1
params.doc: Search line start X, in the baseline frame.

inputs.name: current
inputs.doc: Current pose of the part (from the locator). REQUIRED — missing → NA.

outputs.name: line
outputs.doc: The search line transformed from the baseline frame to the current pose.
